_note: Test-local fixture for lane A specs. Produced by freezing the seeded study against a temporary qualified copy of the governed tree (qualification set in the copy only). Not a shipped package status. Data Validation claims and provenance edges are truncated to two entries each; the *_total fields hold the real counts.

stages.name: Upload and authorize inputs
stages.summary: The study owner authorizes each source. Freezing the manifest pins checksums and starts the run.

input.title: Authorized artifacts
input.detail: Protocol, template, source data, statistics, and pattern inputs

output.title: Frozen manifest
output.detail: Checksums, authority tiers, and owner authorization

stages.control_boundary: The agent cannot add an unapproved source. Only the freeze command leaves this gate.

actions.label: Freeze manifest and start the Pinned Run

stages.name: Parse protocol, template and source data
stages.summary: Format-specific parsers convert each frozen file into normalized facts without changing the originals.

input.title: Frozen files
input.detail: Authorized synthetic protocol, template, and source representations

output.title: Typed source records
output.detail: Normalized study records with source pointers

stages.control_boundary: Parsing may flag ambiguity. It may not repair or overwrite raw study data.

stages.name: Resolve study type and pattern
stages.summary: HELIX resolves the study type and retrieves the approved report pattern for structure only.

output.title: Study profile
output.detail: Resolved study type and report template

stages.control_boundary: Prior reports may guide structure and phrasing. Their values never enter the new study.

stages.name: Deterministic extraction
stages.summary: Code reads the selected source rows and computes report-ready values at the required grain.
stages.control_boundary: The model selects tools and evidence. Deterministic code reads values and performs math.

stages.name: Deterministic validation
stages.summary: Rules check keys, terminology, units, grain, authority, aggregation and source-to-report reconciliation.
stages.control_boundary: A failed rule creates a blocker. The agent cannot downgrade it to green.

stages.name: Structured section drafting
stages.summary: Report sections are assembled around validated claims with explicit review markers for unresolved fields.
stages.control_boundary: The model may write prose. It may not invent a value or make the final scientific judgment.

stages.name: Compile provenance
stages.summary: Every report claim is linked to exact source records, the deterministic transform, validation results and manifest version.
stages.control_boundary: A numeric claim without a provenance edge cannot pass its section gate.

stages.name: Traceability review
stages.summary: A reviewer records a disposition for every blocking result before review and export opens.

output.title: Recorded dispositions
output.detail: each blocker resolved by a named reviewer

stages.control_boundary: Agent execution stops here. A disposition is recorded as a disposition, never as a pass.

stages.name: Review, sign and export
stages.summary: Reviewers sign, the Study Director records Final Study Approval, and an explicit export command releases artifacts.
stages.control_boundary: Approvals can make export ready. Only the explicit export command completes this stage.

results.message: Every body-weight record has grain and projects to study_day × sex × dose_group.
Recomputed body-weight summaries match the frozen fixture.
Every numeric body-weight claim has complete hashes, transforms, and edges.
